product.skirts: per edge: 1.25 × the largest gap to any other level across it + 0.1 × vertex spacing; triangles after glTF primitive extras.surfaceTriangles

sharedVertices.tolerance: sum of both tiles' float32 offset precision (1e-4 m + 4·2⁻²⁴·largest box half-extent)

mixedLodCracksNoSkirts.note: gap between a tile edge vertex and the straight edge of each coarser neighbour present across that edge (fine-coarse level pairs)

parentChildHeights.note: child − parent CPU heights at the parent's own lattice positions, by child level (as validate-terrain.mjs reports for the geographic pyramid)

renderedMesh.simplification: RTIN (all edge vertices kept, full-detail cells split v00→v11 like the lattice), own error ≤ 0.03 × face-centre vertex spacing
renderedMesh.cpuSurface: full lattice of the grid (v00→v11 diagonals); rendered and CPU ray-query surfaces differ
renderedMesh.deviation: tiles[i][5] (km): conservative max radial distance between the rendered (simplified) and the CPU lattice triangles over the tile, float64 positions before the .glb float32 rounding

cpuBilinearVsTriangles.note: radial distance along the same geocentric ray: emitted float32 triangle − (datum + CPU bilinear height); positive = triangle above CPU sample

cases.label: prime meridian equator (px centre: child boundary at every level)

controlPoints.reference: scripts/data/moon-elevations.json — LOLA LDEM 118 m nearest pixel (MoonFall waypoints)

skirts.description: per edge: 1.25 × the largest gap to any other level across it + 0.1 × vertex spacing; triangles after glTF primitive extras.surfaceTriangles

boundaryPicks.note: rays (0–60° off nadir, 2 km) at the worst-gap vertex of mixed-level edges: CPU hit (finest grids) vs the rendered pair (fine tile + coarse neighbour) with skirts; clearance = the #148 camera 50 m along the CPU normal, straight down onto the rendered pair
